name: Timbuktu
description: Timbuktu is a desert city in Mali, just north of the Niger River, that grew rich on trade in salt, gold and ivory. In the 15th and 16th centuries it was a renowned centre of Islamic learning, home to Sankore University. Its three mud-built mosques, Djingareyber, Sankore and Sidi Yahia, still stand, though they face desertification and conflict.
